Class QueryResult

public abstract class QueryResult

Known derived/implementing types:
BankAccountSelector.Result, PricebookEntrySelector.Result, QueryResultTest.ResultTest

Abstract base class for selector query results. Provides a standardized wrapper around SObject record lists with convenience methods for checking emptiness, size, and query exceptions. Selector Result inner classes extend this to provide typed access to specific SObject types.
